summary: Anonymous private patched-product CEF followed this portal actual sign-in transaction to the exact top-document ID MEO POST form. The email, password and Entrar submit controls were observed. Tokens, query parameters, field values and raw HTML were never retained; the fixture is a structural reconstruction of sanitized native metadata, not an authenticated acceptance capture.

sources.title: Anonymous native-runtime form metadata reached from this portal original entry using fresh private cookies and the owned TLS proxy
sources.note: Actual portal entry followed to id.services.telecom.pt/oic and login.telecom.pt/AuthorizeService/authorize.aspx. Native browser scripts executed; the capture tree is reconstructed offline from sanitized form attributes. Transaction queries remained untouched only in browser memory and are absent from artifacts. Original requested URL, final identity URL and actual main-document navigation count are recorded.

fixtures.note: Observed top-document controls, hCaptcha placeholder and hidden response field names. Cross-origin hCaptcha documents were not inspected and contain no captured tree. No scripts, site keys, values, ASP.NET state or transaction queries.

staysInteractive.note: Human hCaptcha is present. No challenge was solved or inspected internally; credential typing is restricted to the top-document email/password controls.
No secondary sign-in challenge was captured or automated; any SMS verification remains the user responsibility.

unverified: Authenticated account sign-in and server acceptance were not attempted.
Human CAPTCHA completion and any secondary account challenge were not exercised.
neededFromUser: Authenticated acceptance would establish post-submit continuation; no account or challenge-solving request was made for this anonymous initial-form review.
